items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms X -> Y -> Z of algebraic spaces over S, if X is locally of finite presentation over Z and Y is locally of finite type over Z, then X -> Y is locally of finite presentation (source lines 5826-5833). The proof chooses a chain of surjective etale presenting morphisms W -> Z, V -> W x_Z Y and U -> V x_Y X with W, V, U schemes; by the definitions U is locally of finite presentation over W and V is locally of finite type over W, so the scheme permanence lemma makes U -> V locally of finite presentation, which by the definition gives the claim for f.
